corpus.unit_proof: widest inter-transition gap in the corpus is 858.727000 s, and 511 ticks at 150 Hz is 3.406667 s — the gap sits exactly on the 9-bit ceiling of the on-wire tick field. So the float in the container is seconds and the capture clock is 150 Hz.

mag_format.layout: u32 transition count, then count × (u32 (trackmask<<4), f32 absolute seconds)

R: 'R' + trackmask; ack 'Ready', then 'RD ' + u16 tick count + payload, then 'RD=OK'
